note: V16.2.0 is published and is now the release the public notice names. It changes NO consensus rule: V16 still activates at #30,000 and the first DTD Jackpot V2 is still #30,186, and a v16.1.0 node and a v16.2.0 node follow the same chain (measured: they accept each other's blocks and agree on every height and every DTD draw, and both read the real production chain identically). What it changes is operator-side - the RPC password, the node heartbeat key and the wallet passphrase can all stay out of the process command line, where any local user could read them with ps, and the terminal no longer echoes a passphrase. Encrypted (v2) wallets are supported end to end and v1 wallets keep working with no conversion and no deadline. Upgrade guide: docs/v16/UPGRADE_V16_2.md. One correction for anyone who tried to verify a binary: the published hashes only reproduce when the build directory is named 'build' - the earlier guides said build-v16/build-v162, which cannot match.
